# Version 4.155.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux fonts and Tizen**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp restores Linux NoDependencies font discovery and raises Tizen native assets to the Tizen 10 platform floor. The bundled m155 fork also receives upstream-alignment cleanup while native Windows build provenance is tightened.

## Breaking Changes

- **Tizen 8 and 9 native assets are no longer supported** — The Tizen native packages now target Tizen 10. Update Tizen applications and build environments to Tizen 10 or later before taking this release. ([#5235](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5235))

## Bug Fixes

- **Linux NoDependencies fonts discovered** — Linux applications using the NoDependencies package can again find installed system fonts through the default font manager. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5086](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5086))
